title: Report: GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 among games leaving PS Plus Extra and Premium on 17 Nov (PlayStation LifeStyle, from the Asian stores' Last Chance to Play list)

sources.note: PlayStation LifeStyle 20 Oct 02:24Z (modified 10:46Z): 12 titles from the Japanese and Asian stores, leaving by Tue 17 Nov; slight variations by region
Insider Gaming 13:10Z credits PSLS (10 titles listed)

sources.url: IGN 4K: GTA Online 'A Safehouse in the Hills' launch trailer; RDR2 PC 4K launch trailer; track from Steam's RDR2 60 FPS trailer

claims.text: GTA V and RDR2 leave PS Plus Extra and Premium on 17 Nov
claims.status: reported (PSLS from the Asian stores; Sony silent)

claims.text: also FM26, Talos Principle 2, Cricket 24, Rock of Ages 3; others in select regions

dl.headline:
لعبتا GTA V وRDR2
تغادران PS Plus
dl.notes: Brief: hook = the two big names leaving; clipcard (trailer and split capped); opener: the GTA mansion over Los Santos; card «موعد المغادرة / 17 نوفمبر / لمشتركي Extra وPremium» over RDR2's coast; line 1 (who reports) on the GTA yacht at sunset, a night street and the RDR2 beach; line 2 (Sony has not confirmed) on the beach, a rider and riders in a field; hard cuts; under it RDR2's opening score from Steam's 60 FPS trailer (2 s, tonal, measured) since both 4K trailers are effects-heavy. 13.1 s. Steam copies were letterboxed to 864 rows; IGN 4K copies (1728 rows) used. Three sheets removed a chase, an explosion, helicopters firing, a chair fight, a gun drawn and dark frames. DeepL back-check: the card alone read 'PS Plus will be discontinued', so its label is «موعد المغادرة».
